dataset.description: Dataset consists of shotgun sequencing data from archaeological bone and teeth samples with and without copper patination.

distribution.title:
Shotgun sequencing data was collected in order to study the effects of copper patination on the preservation of ancient DNA.
Processed DNA was extracted from archaeological bone and tooth samples with and without copper patination.

dataset.title: Characterisation of ancient DNA preservation in human bone and teeth samples from Latvia with copper patination.

dmp.description: This DMP represents data obtained during a study concerned with effects of copper patination on ancient DNA preservation from archaeologically obtained human bones and teeth samples.
